a2_authority.formation_rule: L1 Close(T) >= MA60(T), mature reference, and Close(T) > Reference(T)
a2_authority.reference_formula: max(High(s) for prior 20 accepted sessions strictly before T)

NEXT_SESSION_CLOSE.path_semantics: sessions strictly after the next-session close

NEXT_SESSION_OPEN.path_semantics: entry session through the next h-1 canonical sessions

OBSERVABLE_A2_CLOSE.path_semantics: next canonical sessions strictly after T

THEORETICAL_REFERENCE_FILL.path_semantics: next canonical sessions strictly after T
THEORETICAL_REFERENCE_FILL.timing: A2 signal session; price-only theoretical reference fill

event_deduplication.distinct_event_start: first A2 row for an instrument, or an A2 row whose canonical session index is not immediately after the prior A2 row for that instrument
event_deduplication.persistent_observation: an A2 row immediately following the prior A2 row for the same instrument in canonical session order
event_deduplication.raw_observation_unit: one formed A2 candidate panel row at one accepted canonical trading session

mfe_mae.mae_formula: min(low / entry_price - 1) over the defined next h canonical sessions
mfe_mae.mfe_formula: max(high / entry_price - 1) over the defined next h canonical sessions
mfe_mae.next_close_proxy: path begins strictly after the next-session close
mfe_mae.next_open_proxy: path includes the entry session and the next h-1 sessions
mfe_mae.session_semantics: canonical accepted trading sessions, not calendar days

reference_loss_reclaim.close_loss: first future canonical session with Close < BREAKOUT_REFERENCE_PRICE
reference_loss_reclaim.primary_loss: first future canonical session with Low < BREAKOUT_REFERENCE_PRICE
reference_loss_reclaim.reclaim: first session at or after primary loss with Close >= BREAKOUT_REFERENCE_PRICE
